text:
noah: Heads-up: external assessor arriving next week. We need final signoff on the evidence certification checklist, KMS handling, and how retest bookings are triggered.

rebecca: Proposed evidence package: ndjson logs, SHA256SUMS, a flat manifest.csv, and a .sig file signed by our signing key. Keep the manifest as one-line-per-file CSV to avoid nested parsing.

dinesh: For encryption, use envelope encryption with the internal CMK. Do NOT expose key ARNs. We'll run a decrypt-service that requires assessor to present a short-lived decrypt-token bound to their ephemeral role.

noah: Good. Token TTL 3h default. Extensions need two approvals: eng-security + infra-oncall. All approvals recorded in manifest under approver_ids and approval_ts.

rebecca: Manifest fields recommended: manifest_id, file_name, start_iso, end_iso, service, sha256, signer_id, associated_ticket, triage_ref, severity, cvss_score. All timestamps UTC ISO8601.

dinesh: Audit: all decrypt requests and RBAC grants go to immutable-audit stream. Retention: evidence objects 90 days; audit events 24 months. Also publish a hashed index to coldstore monthly for forensics.

noah: For repro requirement on retests: teams must attach a minimal repro script plus a short before/after log snippet (no PII). Add field `retest_sample` in manifest with s3 path.

rebecca: Automation: when manifest + associated_ticket + remediation PR + two passing CI checks are present, auto-label issue `ready-for-retest` and enqueue to retest scheduler. We should publish the scheduler's API URL in the ticket template.

dinesh: Retest windows: default first slot = 7 days after ready label, second slot = 21 days after. If the assessor requests an emergency early slot, they must open a Slack thread with infra-oncall + eng-security and get both approvals.

noah: Signed integrity: we add detached signature (.sig) using redwood-signing key. Also keep a copy of the exporter binary sha in Exporter-SHA in the manifest.

rebecca: Example commands we'll ship to squads:
```
./pt-evidence-export --from 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-07-01T04:00:00Z --out /tmp/pt.tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/pt.tar.gz > /tmp/SHA256SUMS
redwood-sign /tmp/pt.tar.gz > /tmp/pt.tar.gz.sig
aws s3 cp /tmp/pt.tar.gz s3://redwood-evidence/pt-<manifest_id>/
aws s3 cp /tmp/SHA256SUMS s3://redwood-evidence/pt-<manifest_id>/
aws s3 cp /tmp/pt.tar.gz.sig s3://redwood-evidence/pt-<manifest_id>/
```

dinesh: Decrypt flow snippet: assessor requests decrypt-token via decrypt-service UI -> service validates ephemeral role -> mints token bound to artifact id -> assessor uses token to stream decrypted payload. Token issuance is logged. No keys returned.

audit-bot: Reminder: generate manifest_id format pt-<engagement>-<unix>. Record exporter sha and signer_id.

rebecca: Emergency extension policy: assessor posts request in #eng-security with justification. infra-oncall must respond within 30m. If no response, escalate to SRE lead. All extensions appended to manifest.csv and immutable-audit.

noah: Add to ticket checklist: upload manifest, attach SHA file, attach .sig, PR reference, repro sample, confirmation ephemeral roles revoked post-fix. If any item missing, scheduler will not accept retest.

dinesh: Also add object-lock during retest window: set GOVERNANCE mode for evidence objects and set retention to engagement_end + 30d. Coldstore index set legal-hold until 2032-01-01.

retest-scheduler: Note: when ticket auto-labels ready-for-retest the first available slot will be at +7 days. If a team prefers a specific date, add preferred slots in the ticket body using ISO dates.

rebecca: One subtlety: include `pre_access_snapshot` and `post_access_snapshot` references in manifest for RBAC change audits. Captures who had which roles immediately before/after grant and revoke.

noah: Action items: Dinesh - build decrypt-token prototype + audit hooks; Rebecca - author export docs + manifest template; I'll update the GitHub issue template and scheduler docs. Dry-run scheduled Wed 2026-06-23 14:00 UTC.

dinesh: Prototype tomorrow.

rebecca: Docs PR by EOD Fri.

noah: Thanks. Keep updates short in dry-run outputs. :white_check_mark:
